angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 884,374 km at 46.97 pc = 0.25 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 21.2910 +/- 0.0285 mas (same row, RUWE 0.99): 46.97 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.271 (1.246 to 1.297) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 884,374 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.919 (0.879 to 0.959) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5502 +/- 1.6 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 955758320761687680: teff_gspphot 5502.319 K (16th-84th percentiles 5501.28-5504.5), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 955758320761687680: teff_gspphot 5502.319 K (16th-84th percentiles 5501.28-5504.5), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/lucilinburhuc.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.193, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 45350 (pscomppars): spectral type G5 V, from Marcy et al. 2005 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2005ApJ...619..570M/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HD 45350: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 45350 (pscomppars): [M/H] 0.23 dex, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 45350 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.14065, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 45350 (pscomppars): age 8 Gyr, from Marcy et al. 2005 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2005ApJ...619..570M/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 45350 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1.4 km/s, from Valenti & Fischer 2005 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2005ApJS..159..141V/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
